# Aniora

> Aniora (https://aniora.qzz.io) is a free anime streaming site with AniList sync. It lets viewers browse trending, seasonal, and classic anime, then stream episodes in sub or dub through an embedded player. There is no signup, and progress can optionally sync to a user's AniList account.

## Content

- Home — [https://aniora.qzz.io/](https://aniora.qzz.io/): Trending, seasonal, and popular anime
- Anime — [https://aniora.qzz.io/anime](https://aniora.qzz.io/anime): Browse TV anime by trending / popular / top / recent
- Movies — [https://aniora.qzz.io/movies](https://aniora.qzz.io/movies): Anime films by popularity, score, trend, recency
- Search — [https://aniora.qzz.io/search](https://aniora.qzz.io/search): Filter by title, genre, format, status, year, score
- Anime info — https://aniora.qzz.io/anime/{anilistId}: Full details, synopsis, stats, cast, trailer
- Watch — https://aniora.qzz.io/watch/{anilistId}?ep={episodeNumber}: Player with sub/dub toggle and episode list

## Guides

- [Best Anime Websites 2026](https://aniora.qzz.io/blog/best-anime-websites): Comparison of free anime streaming sites

## Notes

- Data source: AniList GraphQL (https://graphql.anilist.co) for metadata; Zenshin mapping API for episode data; MegaPlay embed for the player.
- No user files or media are hosted on Aniora's server — playback is served from third-party embeds.
- AniList sync is optional; local wishlist and history work without login.
